definitions.explanation: A favorable time or situation for doing something.
A particular time when something happens.

examples.japanese: {機会|きかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{行|い}きたい→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: If I have the chance, I'd like to go.

examples.japanese: ⟦せっかく→折角：04361_sekkaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{機会|きかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}さないようにしよう→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧。
examples.english: Let's make sure we don't miss this valuable opportunity.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{機会|きかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{礼|れい}→お礼：01359_orei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}いたい→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I'd like to take this occasion to express my thanks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{機会|きかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I don't have many occasions to use Japanese.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧{機会|きかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The meeting became a good occasion to talk with people from overseas.

notes:
{機会|きかい} means 'opportunity' or 'chance.'

Homophone: {機械|きかい} (machine) - same reading, different meaning!

Common collocations:
- {機会|きかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have an opportunity
- {機会|きかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}す→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧: to miss an opportunity
- {機会|きかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take advantage of an opportunity
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{機会|きかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: on this occasion

Similar words:
- ⟦チャンス→チャンス：03857_chansu⟧: chance (casual)
- ⟦{好機|こうき}→好機：12221_kouki⟧: favorable opportunity (formal)
